next_lesson: A historical imbalance is a location and memory of fast repricing, not a payer. First-touch acceptance/rejection based on completed price alone does not identify live sponsored inventory or forced flow at cost scale.
why: The broadest actionable surface was negative before realistic non-price cost. The best 2022 zero-cost account ended 0.951265x with 239 completed trades, negative median and negative second half; at 24bp it ended 0.529068x. Traversal was substantially worse. Winner deletion reduced the best 24bp path to 0.467770x. No formation grid had >=60 trades and nonnegative 24bp mean, so conditional ML was correctly not opened.
